classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

areas.area: Agent identities, owners, lifecycle and risk controls are explicit
areas.requirement: Agents require tenant, owner, purpose, version and scope; lifecycle transitions and risk profiles control deployment and autonomy.

areas.area: Agent execution context is tenant-bound and cross-tenant action fails closed
areas.requirement: Agent execution validates tenant scope, rejects cross-tenant operations and keeps context attributable to actor/session/execution.

areas.area: Agent tasks are ordered, bounded, checkpointed and cancellable
areas.requirement: Tasks reject skipped transitions, enforce deadlines/retry ceilings, support checkpoints/resume and preserve cancellation authority and metadata.

areas.area: Agent governance rules are tied to executable checks
areas.requirement: Governance reports derive task state, memory trust, plan validation, loop safety and tenant-scoped agent checks from enforcing modules and tests.

areas.area: Agent memory and model intelligence do not become authority
areas.requirement: Agent governance preserves trust/classification boundaries and keeps permissions, canonical architecture and human approval outside model preference.

areas.area: Agent societies coordinate collectively with durable audit and suspension
areas.requirement: Society formation, collective actions, inter-agent negotiation, individual attribution, suspension and society-level audit execute at a live authorized boundary.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
